name: Marginalia
author: Sajjad Heydari
description: A hidden context menu on cards, verbs and aspects. Alt + right-click to write a note in the margins.
description_long: Hold Alt and right-click any card, verb, aspect icon, or open verb/card/aspect window to open a hidden context menu. For now the menu holds one thing: a persistent note for that element or verb, shared across all your saves. Notes are kept in marginalia.json next to your save files. The modifier can be changed by adding marginalia_modifier=ctrl (or shift) to config.ini.
